text.p: Oriole Homes Corp said Friday that it would delay the filing of its 10-Q report with the Securities and Exchange Commission, and that as a result, the American Stock Exchange would halt trading in its shares.
The comapny also said that it expected to report a "significant" writedown in the vaue of its assets when it files the report by August 22.

Oriole said the dealy was caused by various circumstances, including the termination of a proposed transaction that would have resulted in a controlling interest being held by BankAtlantic Bancorp Inc.

Oriole added that the termination of the deal on August 8 left it with insufficient time to conduct a revaluation of its land and certain investment assets, which it expected to lead to the writedown.
Oriole is a builder of homes and apartments in Palm Beach, Broward, Martin, Lee and Marion counties in Florida.
